views.name: leaderboard
views.definition:
SELECT COALESCE(u.nickname, u.anonymous_name, 'Usuário'::character varying) AS display_name,
    g.xp_points,
    g.best_score,
    g.total_quizzes,
    g.current_streak,
    g.badges,
    rank() OVER (ORDER BY g.xp_points DESC) AS rank
   FROM gamification g
     JOIN users u ON u.id = g.user_id
  WHERE u.is_active = true OR u.is_active IS NULL
  ORDER BY g.xp_points DESC;

views.name: user_stats
views.definition:
WITH quiz_stats AS (
         SELECT quiz_history.user_id,
            count(*) AS total_quizzes,
            COALESCE(avg(quiz_history.percentage), 0::numeric)::numeric(5,2) AS avg_score,
            COALESCE(max(quiz_history.percentage), 0::numeric) AS best_score,
            COALESCE(sum(quiz_history.time_spent_secs), 0::bigint) AS total_time_secs,
            count(DISTINCT quiz_history.certification) AS certifications_practiced
           FROM quiz_history
          WHERE quiz_history.status::text = 'completed'::text
          GROUP BY quiz_history.user_id
        ), focus_stats AS (
         SELECT focus_sessions.user_id,
            COALESCE(sum(focus_sessions.minutes) FILTER (WHERE focus_sessions.session_type = 'focus'::session_type), 0::bigint) AS total_focus_minutes
           FROM focus_sessions
          GROUP BY focus_sessions.user_id
        )
 SELECT u.id AS user_id,
    COALESCE(u.nickname, u.anonymous_name, 'Usuário'::character varying) AS display_name,
    u.nickname,
    u.anonymous_name,
    u.role,
    COALESCE(qs.total_quizzes, 0::bigint) AS total_quizzes,
    COALESCE(qs.avg_score, 0::numeric)::numeric(5,2) AS avg_score,
    COALESCE(qs.best_score, 0::numeric) AS best_score,
    COALESCE(qs.total_time_secs, 0::bigint) AS total_time_secs,
    COALESCE(qs.certifications_practiced, 0::bigint) AS certifications_practiced,
    COALESCE(fs.total_focus_minutes, 0::bigint) AS total_focus_minutes
   FROM users u
     LEFT JOIN quiz_stats qs ON qs.user_id = u.id
     LEFT JOIN focus_stats fs ON fs.user_id = u.id;
